title: Matrix multiplication II
summary: This is a similar example as [matrix multiplication](https://jsxgraph.org/share/example/matrix-multiplication), but uses [MathJax](https://www.mathjax.org) to display the matrix. Sliders control the entries of a 2×2 transformation matrix that maps the vector to the vector .
